cases.prompt:
Turn these into a Postman collection.

curl -X POST https://api.example.com/v1/login -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"email":"a@b.c","password":"x"}'
curl https://api.example.com/v1/orders -H "Authorization: Bearer TOKEN"
expectations: Outputs collection JSON with info and the v2.1 schema URL.
Replaces the host with a {{baseUrl}} variable and the token with a variable.
Optionally saves the token from login in a test script; both requests are present with correct methods and bodies.

cases.prompt: Create a Postman collection for CRUD on /notes and a matching environment file.
expectations: Includes list, get, create, update and delete requests.
Provides an environment file with baseUrl and other variables.
Uses a noteId variable set from the create response or a path variable.
